HomePlace.SourceString: 异象管理局禁制机动队四队

Introduction.SourceString: 常被认为是E.T.D四队队长的副队长。
Introduction.LocalizedString: Often mistaken for Squad 4's captain, despite being the lieutenant.

Content.SourceString:
这是一个曾被道上弟兄评价为「颇有几分武道家风范」的单字名，翳并不觉得自己的名字有弟兄们所夸的那么好的蕴意，但也不讨厌它，不如说他尤其喜欢按照规范顺序一笔一画将这个字写下时的那股感受——一丝不苟，井井有条的。
只不过，每当用力签下这名字时，他眼前都仿佛会再次浮现出那一日……满怀郑重，在前司的入职合同上签字的景象。
为了那份工作，他全盘接受周遭同事所信奉的一切职场礼仪为「常规」，不曾提出任何疑问，其中就包括了类似于专门对签名技巧加强训练，以求给客户留下精英观感的事项。
这很容易理解，毕竟如果只需将横平竖直顿笔捺角全部考虑进去，就能维持住体面，可谓是过分划算。

至于现在签的……整体字形依然严谨，但细看已经能发现略显急促的连笔。
他不纠结这些表面功夫了？难道他给自己放太久假松懈了？噢，或许也是紧急任务太多、善后又全堆到一起的压力所致……

想要的「正常工作模式」得不到配合，愿意老老实实维护这套系统运转的只有自己一个——好吧，这也没办法。
总之，异象管理局的工作环境还是被逐渐地习惯了下来。以及……怎么说呢，实际上，他也并不反感队友们大大方方开出的玩笑。

另一个例子，则是管理局食堂新来的阿姨，对他也是格外热情。
在盛菜的时候，明明什么也没提，阿姨却特地多舀了好几块带骨小肉排，转头向另一个阿姨说，自家儿子就最爱啃这个！
对方慌忙压低音量——那……那位可不是歧骸啊！是E.T.D四队的副队长！
翳静静地凝视了一会儿那均衡到有些一板一眼的菜品，搭配上头额外多出来的几块带骨小肉排……于是端着走了——他终究没有开口问问阿姨家「儿子」的品种。
Content.LocalizedString:
Skia's name had once been praised by his old colleagues as having "quite the martial artist's spirit." Skia didn't care much for the supposed depth of his name. But he found quiet satisfaction in the act of writing it—each letter placed with purpose, each curve and line falling into place. It was neat, orderly, and well arranged. Just the way he liked.
However, whenever he signed his name with too much force, that scene would always reappear in his mind… That day when he signed his employment contract at his ex-company.
For that job, he completely embraced all the workplace etiquette his colleagues believed in as "standard practice," never questioning any of it. This included things like specialized signature training to leave clients with an elite impression.
It made perfect sense, really—if all it took to preserve one's dignity was to follow a visible, rigid set of rules, then the cost was laughably low for the rewards.

As for his current signature… the overall form remained rigorous, but a closer look revealed slightly hurried connecting strokes.
Had he stopped caring about these surface details? Had taking too much time off made him sloppy? Or perhaps it was the pressure from too many emergency missions piling up with all the cleanup…

Things weren't done the way he wanted. He felt he was the only one willing to maintain the system. Well… there was nothing he could do about that.
Despite that, he gradually got used to working at the BAC. And… how should he put it? He didn't mind the sincere jokes of his teammates.

On the other hand, there was a new cafeteria lady at the Bureau who was particularly enthusiastic about Skia.
When serving him food, though Skia hadn't said anything, she would ladle several extra bone-in ribs, then casually speak to another female staff member about how her son also likes chewing on those ribs.
The other woman lowered her voice, sounding embarrassed. "He… he's not an Oddity! He's the lieutenant from ETD-4!"
Skia quietly stared at the perfectly balanced, almost strict meal composition, topped with those extra bone-in ribs… then picked up his tray and walked away. In the end, he never asked about the "breed" of the lady's son.

Content.SourceString:
在「莱昂国际」，翳觉得自己贯彻着「常规的上班族」这一身份，并且生来就适合这样的生活。
现代文明社会，「觉醒异能就可能改变外貌特征」是早已普及的常识。他的变化幅度确实很夸张，只看一眼就受到了上班五年未曾体会过的冲击……但冷静下来也没什么不能想通的，毕竟不是靠脸吃饭的职业，应不至于打破他的「常规」……
事实是，他的「常规」并不由他自身的心态决定。
当时他在会议室中忍无可忍地站起，强行维持住礼貌询问为什么这类一直以来由他负责的业务现在连报告都不经过他手了。
坐在四周衣冠楚楚的「精英」之中，有人眼角处用力皱了皱。翳后来联想到，那是一种……就跟要把掉进眼睛的浑浊物质给挤出去似的动作。
随着会议中断的宣告，翳抬起视线，越过了被迫重新审视的、自我面具的罅隙，对上投影屏中央那块随他站立而浮起的……什么东西的庞大黑色轮廓。
有那么像怪物的影子吗？
好吧，好吧。至少接受了「异能代价」的过程还不算太折磨，现在他是「除去皮囊，哪里都很常规的上班族」。
Content.LocalizedString:
At Leon International, Skia embodied the role of a regular office worker and was naturally suited for that kind of life.
In modern civilized society, the fact that awakening Esper Abilities could change physical appearance was already common knowledge. His transformation was indeed dramatic, and just one look gave him a worse shock than any he'd experienced in five years of work… but once he calmed down, there was nothing he couldn't rationalize. After all, it wasn't a job that depended on looks, so it shouldn't break his routine…
The truth was, his routine wasn't determined by his own mindset.
Back then, he'd stood up in the meeting room, unable to bear it any longer, forcing himself to remain polite as he asked why the projects he'd always handled weren't even going through him for reports anymore.
Sitting among the well-dressed elites around him, someone wrinkled their eyes forcefully. Skia later realized it was the kind of motion… like trying to squeeze out some murky substance that had fallen into their eye.
As the meeting adjourned, Skia raised his gaze, looking past the cracks in his self-imposed mask that he was forced to reexamine, his eyes meeting the massive silhouette in the center of the projection screen that rose with his standing figure.
Does he look like a monster to others?
Well, at least the price of gaining the Esper Ability's wasn't too high. Now he was a regular office worker in every way except appearance.

Content.SourceString:
「可不是温水煮青蛙嘛……」
喝酒时，坐在左手边的男人细声对酒保诉苦，他苦恼于自身的困境——因在职场各个细枝末节积累的一点点压力而陷入了某种必须将浑身上下每一根弦都绷紧的状况，想逃走的话……怕是免不了遭受番皮开肉绽之苦，男人正为此踌躇不已。
「希望下次在这里看到你的时候，别再像这样克制地抿酒了……彻底崩溃一次，方能下决心挣脱。解酒药，不是靠喝进去的，而是吐出来的。」
坐在右手边，气场凶横、脸上刀疤累累的男人如此隔空回应道。他那与外表截然相反、慢条斯理的讲话方式引起了翳的注意。
与那个人成为朋友，是他意识到自己其实不论身在何处，都有能力构建起「常规」系统的开始。
如果，在作为混乱与危险代名词的「那条道」上，也有规矩，有秩序，有明确「项目目标」的话……
Content.LocalizedString:
"It's like being a frog slowly boiled alive…"
While drinking, the man on his left complained to the bartender about his predicament. The man was troubled, trapped in a state where every fiber of his being couldn't relax due to workplace pressure. If he wanted to escape, he'd inevitably face brutal consequences. The man was deeply conflicted about this.
"Next time I see you here, I hope you won't be sipping your drink with such restraint… You can only break free if you break down completely for once. You don't cure alcohol by drinking a cure. You simply throw up."
The man sitting on his right, with a menacing aura and face of scars, responded across the space. His deliberate, unhurried way of speaking, which contrasted sharply with his appearance, caught Skia's attention.
Becoming friends with that person marked the beginning of Skia realizing that he had the ability to build a routine wherever he was.
If on that chaotic and dangerous path, there were rules, order, and clear objectives, then perhaps…

Content.SourceString:
身姿挺拔的漆黑猛犬，在打火机光亮凿出的洞中探出头展开监视。
下一秒，因发现打火机遭到更换而显而易见地流露出后压耳朵的低落情绪。
莫非它心底里还是更喜欢原来那个吗？——翳暗想。但特地解释「那上头印着前司LOGO，不换回去了」之类，似乎又太过愚蠢、缺乏效率、形式主义……和自己的异能沟通本应通过内在调节处理完成，再怎么说，异能所反映的是自己。
该项问题被挂起、搁置到最后的结果，自然就是接受现在的这副形态。
Content.LocalizedString:
The imposing black hound poked its head out from the hole carved by the lighter's flame, keeping watch. Once it discovered the lighter had been replaced, its ears flattened, showing signs of dejection.
"Did the hound really prefer the original lighter?" Skia wondered. But giving an explanation like "I'm not switching back because that one had my ex-company's logo" seemed foolish, inefficient, and overly formal… Communication with his own Esper Ability should done internally. After all, the ability was a reflection of himself.
The issue was shelved, and the final result was a naturally acceptance of this current form.

Content.SourceString:
可在「菲女士」处点单的特调咖啡。
相比「翳前司所规定每日8:00统一饮用的黄金比例晨间咖啡」，多加了3颗方糖和25ml牛奶，可能……还有其他不该出现在咖啡里的调味料……至于咖啡豆产地……唔，或许是抵达了不同的次元吧——硬要描述就是如此差别了。
话说回来，从菲女士脑袋里倒出的咖啡根本就没有「冲泡」这个过程，这种用量的影响只能靠品味后感受，无法计算，但当初的翳仍然尝试了进行精准的表述。
据菲女士所说这款特调咖啡名字的由来，就是为了纪念他刚入职异象管理局，在工位上受自己招待时所露出的、恍如这辈子第一次喝到真正咖啡般的神情——诧异、愣怔、难以判断意思是「超绝美味！」还是「难喝透顶！」的神情。
菲女士放弃了追问他的好恶，随后那舒展开的长叹足以填满全部的感想。
Content.LocalizedString:
A specialty coffee available for order from Ms. Fei.
Compared to the golden ratio morning coffee that Skia's ex-company mandated at 8:00 AM daily, this had… 3 extra sugar cubes, 25 ml extra milk, and… other ingredients that shouldn't appear in coffee. As for the coffee beans' origin… Well, perhaps it's from a different dimension. That was about the best way to describe the drink.
The coffee poured from Ms. Fei's head wasn't exactly brewed. The recipe isn't something one can expect—one had to taste it. But back then, Skia still tried to describe the drink with precise words.
Ms. Fei said she named the coffee after seeing Skia react to coffee she served him after he joined the BAC—it was as if he never had a real cup of coffee before. The look on his face was a mix of surprise and bewilderment, making it impossible to tell whether he was thinking it was absolutely delicious! or utterly awful!
Ms. Fei gave up asking about his preferences, and the long sigh that followed was enough to sum up all his thoughts.

Content.SourceString:
要是偷听过J.T.F队员们的八卦闲谈，你会发现在他们口中，翳因具备靠谱干练明事理没怪脾气没神奇嗜好等等他若干同事所不具备的优良素质而有着相当高的评价！
「那边有太多人不好相处了，说真的特别怕。但和翳副队交接就正常到不可思议，他又稳重又熟练，比我还清楚我这要交的文件有哪些，简直就像已经上了二十年班……」
「呜呼——翳前辈太不容易了，他是孤独的负重前行者，是怪人大军中绝无仅有的秩序之影，是我行我素的汹涌浪潮里唯一一艘坚持朝流程规范化逆向航行的小船……」
对他在E.T.D中的定位和发展前景分析……却不知怎的能嚼出点凄凉的味道来。
Content.LocalizedString:
If you ever eavesdrop on JTF members, you'd discover that Skia has quite a high reputation among them for being reliable, competent, and reasonable. They'd say that he has no weird temper and no strange hobbies, as well as other great qualities many of his colleagues lack!
"There are too many difficult people over there, honestly it's pretty scary. But working with Lieutenant Skia is incredibly easy. He's steady and skilled, he knows what documents I need to hand over better than I do. It's like he's been working for twenty years…"
 "Oh man, Skia has it so tough. He's bears burdens alone; he acts as the only pillar of order in group of weirdos; he's the sole boat stubbornly sailing against the current; he struggles to impose procedures amid a raging tide of individualism…"
Their analysis of his role and development prospects in ETD… somehow has a bitter aftertaste.

Content.SourceString: 隶属于异象管理局禁制机动队——担任四队副队长职务的翳。今后的工作中，兴许还会有更多需要寻求协作的情况。
Content.LocalizedString: Lieutenant Skia, Squad 4, Enforcement Tactical Division. Perhaps we might meet at work again in the future.

Content.SourceString: 不论学习还是工作，每个人都深受其所处环境的影响，并在无形中成为该环境的一部分——环境的选择是双向的。
Content.LocalizedString: Whether in studies or work, everyone is deeply influenced by their environment and unconsciously becomes part of it—it goes both ways.

Content.SourceString: 你是在对这个城市一无所知也没有做过任何准备的前提下过来的，所以「伊波恩」的节奏也会塑造你在此处的生活节奏吧。你觉得怎么样？是适合自己的吗？
Content.LocalizedString: You came to this city without any prior knowledge or preparation, so I imagine Eibon will shape your life here. What do you think? Is this life for you?

Content.SourceString: 见到白藏的话能麻烦督促他立即回我消息吗？我把他翘掉的会议记录整理好发他手机上了，他今天之内必·须过目。
Content.LocalizedString: If you see Baicang, could you please ask him to reply to my message as soon as possible? I've organized the meeting minutes he missed and sent them to his phone. We need him to GO THROUGH them by today.

Content.SourceString: 阳光在头顶直射的时段，我的影子将很难从脚下扩散出去，不过相对的……浓缩、鲜明的影子在短距离下，力道会更为强劲。
Content.LocalizedString: When the sun is directly overhead, it's harder for my shadow to spread from beneath my feet. However… within short distances, the condensed and distinct shadow packs a way stronger punch.

Content.SourceString: 天气潮湿，户外工作会受到不小的影响，并不只有地面打滑这一方面而已。务必要留意那些会因为天气变化而改变行为模式的异象。
Content.LocalizedString: The humid weather will significantly impact outdoor operations, and it's not just about slippery surfaces. Make sure to watch out for anomalies that adapt their patterns based on weather changes.

Content.SourceString: 我不冷……但指望靠我取暖不是个好主意。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not cold… but don't count on me as a heat source.

Content.SourceString: 这种天气下我多少也会心情烦躁，不过，没有必要一直盯着看，我并非真正的犬类，你想象中的那种散热行为……是不会做的！
Content.LocalizedString: This weather makes me irritable, but I'm not a dog—you won't catch me panting to cool down!

Content.SourceString: 早上好。今天打算先处理哪项工作？
Content.LocalizedString: Good morning. Where should we start today?

Content.SourceString: 局里食堂饭菜的口味，无功无过吧。秩序井然地排队领餐、用餐，确实很有效率……但每天吃会厌倦，也很正常。
Content.LocalizedString: The food at the Bureau's cafeteria is neither good nor bad. The orderly queuing and dining system is certainly efficient, but it's only natural to get tired of eating there every day.

Content.SourceString: 在E.T.D没有确切的下班时间，而是要求随时保持待命的心态。不用顾忌什么，有事随时叫我吧。
Content.LocalizedString: ETD doesn't have fixed off-duty hours—we're expected to be ready for deployment at any time. Don't hesitate to call me whenever something comes up.

Content.SourceString: 一天下来辛苦了，早些休息。
Content.LocalizedString: You've worked hard today. Get some rest.

Content.SourceString: 很难说我个人有什么特别喜欢做的事。非要说的话，我比较喜欢那种……让自己待处理的各项事务，都保持在稳步推进之下的感觉。
Content.LocalizedString: It's hard to say I have any particular hobbies. If I had to choose, I suppose I prefer… the feeling of seeing all my tasks progressing steadily toward completion.

Content.SourceString: 烦恼吗？……是指有关白藏还是法帝娅的？……安魂曲心智还不成熟，偶尔做出一些出格的举动，惹出一些小骚乱，也在情理之中……那两个成年人也一天到晚不务正业到处惹麻烦，实在很难不让人头疼。
Content.LocalizedString: Troubles? …With Baicang or Fadia? …Well, it's understandable that Lacrimosa acts out sometimes and causes minor disturbances… But those two are adults slacking off and causing problems. It's hard not to get a headache from it.

Content.SourceString: 「菲女士」的咖啡……味道十分独特，但提神效果很好，我并不讨厌。况且也没有其他选择，在工位泡茶的话她会生气的，所以想喝茶得去外头。
Content.LocalizedString: Ms. Fei's coffee has… a unique flavor, but it keeps you alert. I don't mind it. She gets upset if we brew tea at our desks, so we have to go outside for that.

Content.SourceString: 「Agent.LUCK」几乎承担了局里所有没人愿意做的文书工作——枯燥乏味，而又漫无止境。只因坚信全部做完主人就会回家……每当看到它努力的模样，我就会想到那个失踪在彩光中至今仍无下落的职员，想到我们也无从下手的、悬而未决的事件，仍有那么多……
Content.LocalizedString: Agent.LUCK handles all the paperwork nobody else at the Bureau wants to do. Tedious and endless as it may be. It persists in the belief that its master will return home once everything is complete… Watching it work diligently reminds me of that staff member who vanished into the lights and remains missing to this day, and of all the unresolved cases we still haven't found a way to tackle…

Content.SourceString: 嗯，我在一个……你兴许听过名字的企业干了很久，后来混过道上，而如今供职于公权机构。有人说我的简历挺不同寻常的，不过回头看来，又好像都是在摸索适合自己的「寻常」，为此不断试错。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes, I worked for quite a while at a company… one you might have heard of. Then I spent some time working with some outlaws, and now I serve in a public institution. Some say my resume is rather unusual, but looking back, perhaps it was all just trial and error in search of where I belong.

Content.SourceString: 你是在疑惑为什么我明明操控的是自己的影子，影子的性情却看起来和我本人不太一样吗……？这解释起来可能会有些抽象。只能说，觉醒异能后，随着我对自己应处定位的理解加深，也认识到无需在表面功夫上时时刻刻保持紧绷，它看上去就变得比最初更富有活力了。
Content.LocalizedString: Are you wondering why my shadow seems to have a different temperament from me, even though I'm the one controlling it…? It might be a bit abstract to explain. Let's just say that after awakening my Esper Ability, and as I gained a deeper understanding of my role, I realized I didn't need to maintain a tense facade all the time. That's when my shadow started appearing more energetic than before.

Content.SourceString: 在觉醒异能的同时拥有了兽化特征是非常普遍的情况，但你也看得出来，我身体的兽化程度比其他人严重得多。那天，我也极力保持冷静，试图以往常的理智与礼貌去维护原有的生活节奏，但似乎不可避免地，还是失去了融入周遭「精英」们的资格……恐怕是「代价」吧。
Content.LocalizedString: It's quite common for Esper ability awakenings to come with transfer characteristics, but as you can see, my physical transformation is far more severe than most. That day, I tried my best to stay calm, attempting to maintain my usual routine with rationality and courtesy. But inevitably, I lost my place among the usual "elites"… I suppose that was the "price" I had to pay.

Content.SourceString: 自那之后确实有过一段时间觉得，就像是习以为常的立身之所崩塌了一般……不过没关系，现在我早已并不在乎那份工作，和那个地方所制定的标准了。
Content.LocalizedString: After that, I did go through a period where it felt like the foundation I'd built my life on had crumbled… But it's fine now—I've long since stopped caring about that job and the standards it set for me.

Content.SourceString: 局长是一位有魄力的领导者。不过，她并不太在意下属各自的行事作风如何，而是只着眼于成效……这一点，可能也是E.T.D中这么多自由生长的个性派都能得到纵容的原因吧……
Content.LocalizedString: The director is a leader of great resolve. However, she doesn't particularly mind how her subordinates conduct themselves, rather focusing solely on results… Perhaps that's why the ETD can afford to be so lenient with its many free spirits…

Content.SourceString: 白藏说自己「很累」「干不下去了」「受了好重的伤」……类似这些话的时候，不用真的去费心迁就他。还有闲心说废话，就表明没什么大碍，这是相处下来的经验之谈。
Content.LocalizedString: When Baicang says he's "exhausted", "done for", or "gravely injured"… don't waste your energy on him… If he speaks, he's alive enough. Talking from experience.

Content.SourceString: 有次和法帝娅一起出外勤，撞见了以前道上的熟人，迫于当时情势……聊了一会。后来他竟然又私下追问我「现在做的工作到底正不正经」……一想到，同事在外头的形象真的会很大程度影响到他人对你的职场，乃至于你个人的印象，我就心生疲惫……
Content.LocalizedString: One time… field duty with Fadia… I ran into an old acquaintance from the past. We chatted for a bit… the guy asked me if "I am working an honest job or not"… Thinking about how colleagues' public image can greatly influence others' perception of the workplace and the job… I'm tired of this…

Content.SourceString: 如果我不去接安魂曲或者提前和她汇合的话……她甚至很有可能，会因为弄丢自己的证件而不被允许进入现场，相比较而言，睡过头迟到和迷路可能都是小事了。
Content.LocalizedString: If I don't pick up Lacrimosa or meet her early… she might not even be allowed on site because she doesn't have her ID. Compared to that, oversleeping or getting lost are very minor concerns.

Content.SourceString: 过去我认为，在一个大规模的企业中做一份中层的稳定工作、精准「有序」地生活，便是最好也最适合自己的。未曾想过会和管理局这种专门负责处理「意外」的组织扯上什么关联……世事难料，重重「意外」将我推到了这个位置，而这种每天都需要处理「意外」的生活，渐渐成为了对我而言的「有序」……
Content.LocalizedString: I used to think the ideal path for me was a stable management position in a large corporation, living a perfectly ordered life. I never imagined I'd get involved with an organization like the bureau that handles emergencies. Life is unpredictable—a series of unexpected turns brought me here, and now this daily routine of handling the unexpected has gradually become my new sense of order…

Content.SourceString: 放在以前我多少难以容忍手下部门中存在欠缺团队协调能力、过于我行我素的家伙。现在在这里……恐怕不能接受与这类同僚共事的人，才是不适应者。
Content.LocalizedString: In the past, I would have had little tolerance for subordinates who lacked team spirit or were too much of an individual. But now, here… those who can't accept working with such spirits are probably the ones who don't fit in.
